integrity: The proof is self-contained apart from standard binomial central limit and elementary probability results; exact rational tests are supplementary finite diagnostics. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact one-step result for lower-median rank selection under uniform sampling without replacement and strictly ordered residuals; no long-run divergence claim or general result for independently accepted update rows. Gaussian crossover assumes even k, m=k^3, and c/m tending to zero.
title: Sharp rank-band amplification in small-sample quantile Kaczmarz
